name: kilo-code
description: Open Source AI coding agent that generates code from natural language, automates tasks, and runs terminal commands. Features inline autocomplete, browser automation, automated refactoring, and custom modes for planning, coding, and debugging. Supports 500+ AI models including Claude (Anthropic), Gemini, Grok, GPT, Codex and GLM.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.agentManager.description: Automatically name new Agent Manager branches when the conversation describes a clear task. Explicitly named and published branches are never renamed.
Prefix for automatically named Agent Manager branches, for example 'marius/' or 'feature/'. Explicit branch names are unchanged.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.experimental.description: Allow Agent Manager to manage sessions and worktrees across multiple repositories as projects. The current workspace repository is always the default project; additional projects can be added and persist across restarts.
Enable the experimental Agent Manager browser panel and browser_open tool.
Experimental one-time import of supported global Claude Code instructions, simple skills, and disabled MCP definitions into Kilo. The original Claude files are never changed.

enumDescriptions: Open or focus the VS Code integrated terminal.
Open or focus an embedded terminal in the Agent Manager side panel.
hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.agentManager.description: Default destination for the Agent Manager terminal button and Focus Terminal keyboard shortcut. The terminal button's dropdown remembers its own choice per Agent Manager panel; this setting only applies to panels that never picked one.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.indexing.sho.description: Show the codebase indexing button below the prompt while indexing is disabled.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.claudeCodeCo.description: Load CLAUDE.md instructions and skills from your Claude Code configuration directory into Kilo sessions. Enable this if you want Kilo to use your Claude Code instructions and skills.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.extraCaCerts.description: Absolute path to a PEM file containing extra CA certificates to trust when the Kilo backend makes HTTPS requests (sets NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS on the CLI process). Use this if you're behind a corporate proxy that performs SSL inspection. Leave empty to rely on the OS trust store.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.autoApprove..description: Start Kilo Code with the main auto-approve toggle enabled. When enabled, permission prompts are approved automatically.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.maxCost.description: Show a non-blocking alert when a session exceeds this USD amount. Use whole dollars; set to 0 to disable.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for the Kilo Code webview UI.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.browserAutom.description: Use system-installed Google Chrome. Disable only when a compatible Playwright Chromium browser is already installed.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.attention.en.description: Play sounds when sessions complete, error, or need input

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.attention.no.description: Show VS Code notifications when Kilo completes a task or needs input. Notifications are suppressed while a Kilo panel is active.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.attention.OS.description: Show native OS notification alerts when Kilo completes a task or needs input while VS Code is not active.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.attention.so.description: Use different sounds for completion, input, and errors, or choose one sound for every event

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.showTaskTime.description: Show the task timeline graph in the chat header

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.showTokenThr.description: Show tokens-per-second (prompt-processing / text-generation) badges on assistant messages and the task header

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.showAutoAppr.description: Show a line on tool calls explaining why they were auto-approved (matched rule, agent default, YOLO mode, etc.)

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.chat.shiftTa.description: Cycle through reasoning effort variants with Shift+Tab in prompt inputs. Disable to keep Shift+Tab for keyboard focus navigation.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.agentManager.description: Agent Manager: when you send pull request CI failures or review comments to the agent, or update a worktree from its base, ask the agent to commit and push so the pull request updates. Permission prompts still apply. Disable to keep commits manual.

hybrid-ai-runtime.kilo-code.diff.renderM.description: Render Markdown files in Kilo diff viewers by default. Toggle this from a Markdown file header in the diff viewer.
